# projectious.work

> Documentation, blog and marketing pages on the projectious.work brand system.


## Documentation

Install, configure, author, extend and maintain the projectious.work Hugo theme.

- [Getting started](https://projectious-work.github.io/brand-theme-hugo-vanilla/v0.3.1/docs/getting-started/): Create a Hugo site from scratch, install the theme from a release or local checkout, configure its outputs and run it.
- [Site-wide configuration](https://projectious-work.github.io/brand-theme-hugo-vanilla/v0.3.1/docs/configuration/site-wide/): Configure Hugo, outputs, Markdown, menus, languages and theme parameters.
- [Versioned documentation](https://projectious-work.github.io/brand-theme-hugo-vanilla/v0.3.1/docs/features/versioning/): Publish separate documentation builds and connect them with the version menu.
- [Page configuration (front matter)](https://projectious-work.github.io/brand-theme-hugo-vanilla/v0.3.1/docs/configuration/page-configuration/): Control navigation, cards, tables of contents and optional page capabilities.
- [Template authoring guide](https://projectious-work.github.io/brand-theme-hugo-vanilla/v0.3.1/docs/guides/template-authoring/): Move from Markdown authoring to your first upgrade-safe Hugo shortcode and layout, step by step.
- [Tokens and public API](https://projectious-work.github.io/brand-theme-hugo-vanilla/v0.3.1/docs/features/tokens/): Inspect the stable semantic CSS tokens and Tailwind namespaces generated from the theme source.
- [Terminal recordings](https://projectious-work.github.io/brand-theme-hugo-vanilla/v0.3.1/docs/features/terminal-recordings/): Record and embed copyable terminal sessions with asciinema.
- [Tailwind and design tokens](https://projectious-work.github.io/brand-theme-hugo-vanilla/v0.3.1/docs/features/tailwind/): Use the theme's Tailwind integration and stable projectious.work design tokens.
- [Shortcodes](https://projectious-work.github.io/brand-theme-hugo-vanilla/v0.3.1/docs/shortcodes/): Every component the theme ships, with the Markdown that produces it.
- [Tags](https://projectious-work.github.io/brand-theme-hugo-vanilla/v0.3.1/docs/features/tags/): Use Hugo taxonomies for related-content and release-note metadata.
- [Developer guide](https://projectious-work.github.io/brand-theme-hugo-vanilla/v0.3.1/docs/developer-guide/): Adapt the theme, swap bundled assets, run tests and contribute changes safely.
- [Search](https://projectious-work.github.io/brand-theme-hugo-vanilla/v0.3.1/docs/features/search/): How the generated search index, header search and command palette work.
- [Maintenance and upgrades](https://projectious-work.github.io/brand-theme-hugo-vanilla/v0.3.1/docs/maintenance/): Keep the theme, runtime pins, content and published documentation current.
- [Mathematics](https://projectious-work.github.io/brand-theme-hugo-vanilla/v0.3.1/docs/features/mathematics/): Render inline and display mathematics with KaTeX.
- [Dependencies and SBOM](https://projectious-work.github.io/brand-theme-hugo-vanilla/v0.3.1/docs/dependencies/): Understand build tools, browser runtimes, bundled assets, versions and licences.
- [Jupyter notebooks](https://projectious-work.github.io/brand-theme-hugo-vanilla/v0.3.1/docs/features/jupyter-notebooks/): Convert and publish reproducible notebook output.
- [Internationalization](https://projectious-work.github.io/brand-theme-hugo-vanilla/v0.3.1/docs/features/internationalization/): Configure translated content, language navigation, metadata and RTL layout.
- [Header and navigation](https://projectious-work.github.io/brand-theme-hugo-vanilla/v0.3.1/docs/features/header-navigation/): Configure primary links, repository actions, search and header controls.
- [Editing and feedback](https://projectious-work.github.io/brand-theme-hugo-vanilla/v0.3.1/docs/features/editing-feedback/): Connect pages to their source files and optionally collect useful reader votes.
- [Diagrams](https://projectious-work.github.io/brand-theme-hugo-vanilla/v0.3.1/docs/features/diagrams/): Render responsive Mermaid diagrams from Markdown.
- [Code blocks](https://projectious-work.github.io/brand-theme-hugo-vanilla/v0.3.1/docs/features/code-blocks/): Configure syntax highlighting, filenames, line numbers, highlighted lines and linkable anchors.
- [Accessibility](https://projectious-work.github.io/brand-theme-hugo-vanilla/v0.3.1/docs/features/accessibility/): Keyboard behavior, reader preferences and author responsibilities.

## Blog

Release notes for the theme.

- [v0.3.0 — pinned runtimes, section-filtered search, command palette](https://projectious-work.github.io/brand-theme-hugo-vanilla/v0.3.1/blog/release-v0-3-0/): Runtime assets are version-pinned, search indexes headings, and every page action sits in one row.
- [v0.2.0 — navy dark mode and the accessibility layer](https://projectious-work.github.io/brand-theme-hugo-vanilla/v0.3.1/blog/release-v0-2-0/): Dark mode moves onto the midnight scale, and every accessibility setting became opt-in.
